# AttackTree for Spec Kit

> Open-source GitHub Spec Kit extension that turns a feature spec into an attack tree (threat actors, attacker goals, AND/OR paths, rated attack vectors, security controls), simulates which controls cut the paths, publishes controls as CR-### requirements in spec.md, and verifies each control with evidence. MIT licensed. Source: https://github.com/hupe1980/spec-kit-attacktree

## Get started
- [Introduction](https://hupe1980.github.io/spec-kit-attacktree/docs/introduction/): what AttackTree is and how it fits Spec Kit
- [Installation](https://hupe1980.github.io/spec-kit-attacktree/docs/installation/): install sources, preset, workflow, hooks
- [Quickstart](https://hupe1980.github.io/spec-kit-attacktree/docs/quickstart/): run the shipped example, then model your own feature

## Concepts
- [Attack trees](https://hupe1980.github.io/spec-kit-attacktree/docs/attack-trees/): Schneier's method, AND/OR nodes, attacker profiles
- [Risk model](https://hupe1980.github.io/spec-kit-attacktree/docs/risk-model/): likelihood, feasibility, controls, occurrence, residual risk matrix
- [Simulation](https://hupe1980.github.io/spec-kit-attacktree/docs/simulation/): choke points, single points of failure, what-if, roadmap, Monte Carlo
- [Verification](https://hupe1980.github.io/spec-kit-attacktree/docs/evidence/): verdicts, bypass rates, definition of converged
